mintAuthority.summary: nTBILL has reviewed native issuance on Ethereum, Plume, and BNB Chain through NestVault deposit entrypoints plus the still-authorized Ethereum Teller path. The shared Nest admin contract controls the issuance authority and the upgradeable NestVault proxies; Arbitrum has live code but no current issuer-confirmed native mint path and remains unresolved.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on the Teller returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982, confirmed as a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (v1.3.0+L2) via Safe API. In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens.

controls.label: Nest nTBILL shared admin contract (all EVM deployments)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770319, Plume block 87675658, and BSC block 116344431, the nTBILL share and each current NestVault returned owner() = 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a; the shared RolesAuthority 0x0a4f939b5d51157c58ba053275eaf77a782b4996 returned the same owner on all three chains. review.evidence: Mint Authority is scoped to Nest's native issuance on Ethereum, Plume, and BNB Chain; the Solana CCTP/LayerZero representation is bridge machinery and is reviewed separately. The current Nest registry and nTBILL integration guide identify the three EVM share deployments and their NestVault deposit paths. At Ethereum block 25770319, Plume block 87675658, and BSC block 116344431, the current NestVault owner() was 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, authority() was 0x0a4f939b5d51157c58ba053275eaf77a782b4996, RolesAuthority.canCall(NestVault, nTBILL share, enter(...)) returned true, and maxDeposit(address) returned uint256.max. The Ethereum Teller remains authorized for the share enter path and is retained with its 3-of-6 Safe owner; current canCall(manager, nTBILL, manage(address,bytes,uint256)) returned false, so the historical Manager is not counted as a current mint controller. Arbitrum has live code, owner, and nonzero supply but is omitted from the current issuer registry and has no verified current NestVault mint path, so its route remains unresolved rather than being treated as canonical. The nTBILL BoringVault share implementation remains immutable, but the current NestVault mint-critical contracts are transparent proxies: Ethereum and Plume use proxy admin 0xcec84cac23a659217f10ee2a9476d6c4a8901067 and BSC uses 0xc20142d79cbb882a4f6201f312bf1958610a5ec4; both ProxyAdmin owners read 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. Nest publishes issuer-operated NAV and composition data, but no recurring independent reconciliation of total nTBILL liabilities to the portfolio or prudential supervision of the wrapper issuer was found, so economicCapSemantics remains unbounded, reconciliation remains unknown, and supervision remains none.
